# Seconds per package, used by ci-rshard-packages.sh to balance the default (r0..r3) test shards.
# Source: the per-package times `go test` printed in the r0..r3 shard logs of master CI runs 43542487139
# and 43550685514 (2026-11-14, hosted runners), averaged over the two runs and CALIBRATED TO WALL TIME:
# each package's printed elapsed time (taken under load, many packages in parallel on one runner) is
# multiplied by (the shard's Test step wall seconds / the sum of its packages' printed times). Whole
# seconds, minimum 1. A package missing from this file (new) weighs 5; a package this run did not
# print (no tests, or newer than the run) keeps its older value. Refresh occasionally: nothing breaks if
# it goes stale, the split just drifts. The script that derives it from the job logs is not in the repo.
